ideas.pitch: A defensive AI agent harness using layered prompt-injection hardening and defense-in-depth patterns specifically built to secure LLM-powered CTF scoring infrastructure against automated flag extraction.
ideas.title: CTF-Agent-Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the cybersecurity theme of the competition by tackling agentic security and prompt injection, aligning with the technical focus of a CTF event.

ideas.pitch: An automated digital forensics platform that uses deep learning and structural entropy analysis to detect and extract multi-layered steganographic payloads hidden within image and audio assets.
ideas.title: StegoNet-Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a notoriously tedious CTF challenge category (Steganography and Digital Forensics) through automation, saving time during intense competition rounds.

ideas.pitch: An interactive binary exploitation assistant that parses compiled ELF binaries, identifies ROP gadgets, and automates exploit chain generation for buffer overflow and format string vulnerabilities.
ideas.title: Binary-Pwn-Pilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses Binary Exploitation (Pwn), which is typically one of the highest-scoring and most difficult categories in CTF competitions.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance cryptographic analysis toolkit specialized in lattice-based cryptography and RSA padding oracle attacks, leveraging parallelized solving routines.
ideas.title: Crypto-Lattice-Cracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a robust, hard-engineering solution for complex cryptographic challenges, appealing to judges looking for deep mathematical and algorithmic implementation.

ideas.pitch: An open-source intelligence aggregation dashboard that correlates metadata, social footprints, and leaked credentials to map digital attack surfaces for targets during CTF reconnaissance phases.
ideas.title: OSINT-Mesh-Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Automates the initial reconnaissance phase of OSINT challenges, demonstrating practical utility for both offensive security research and defensive intelligence gathering.
